commands.pick: Simulators: Choose a Simulation for the Active View

tools.set: Simulates a colour vision deficiency (protanopia, protanomaly, deuteranopia, deuteranomaly, tritanopia, tritanomaly, achromatopsia, achromatomaly), a vision impairment (myopia, cataract, glaucoma, macular-degeneration, low-contrast) or the surroundings (sunlight, dimmed) in the target views; "none" removes it. severity (0 to 1) sets the strength where a simulation has one. Without target the active view; without type it answers every view's simulation and the catalogue.

errors.bad_args: Simulators got a value it cannot use: {reason}
errors.no_view: There is no active view to simulate in. Click into a view and try again.

protanopia.name: Protanopia
protanopia.description: No red cones: reds look dark and close to greens (about 1 % of men).

protanomaly.name: Protanomaly
protanomaly.description: Weak red cones: reds look duller and closer to greens.

deuteranopia.name: Deuteranopia
deuteranopia.description: No green cones: greens and reds are hard to tell apart (about 1 % of men).

deuteranomaly.name: Deuteranomaly
deuteranomaly.description: Weak green cones, the most common colour deficiency (about 5 % of men).

tritanopia.name: Tritanopia
tritanopia.description: No blue cones: blues and greens, yellows and pinks are confused.

tritanomaly.name: Tritanomaly
tritanomaly.description: Weak blue cones: blues look greener, yellows paler.

achromatopsia.name: Achromatopsia
achromatopsia.description: No colour at all: brightness only.

achromatomaly.name: Achromatomaly
achromatomaly.description: Very weak colour vision: colours look washed out.

myopia.name: Blurred vision (myopia)
myopia.description: Everything is out of focus; the strength sets how much.

cataract.name: Cataract
cataract.description: A clouded, yellowed lens: blurred, low in contrast, with glare.

glaucoma.name: Glaucoma (tunnel vision)
glaucoma.description: The edges of the view are lost; only the centre stays clear.

macular-degeneration.name: Macular degeneration
macular-degeneration.description: A blurred, dark spot in the centre of the view.

low-contrast.name: Low contrast sensitivity
low-contrast.description: Light and dark lie closer together.

sunlight.name: Direct sunlight
sunlight.description: A bright, washed-out screen with little contrast.

panel.title: Simulators
panel.no_view: No active view: click into a view, then choose again.
panel.strength_hint: Leave it untouched and Chromium draws the types it knows itself.
panel.shift_hint: Shift+click or Shift+Enter applies the choice to every view.
panel.kept_active: {type} stays in {label}; removed from the other views.

default.label: Simulation of a view without its own
default.description: What every view shows until you choose another simulation for it - usually Off. Ctrl+Shift+Space O I chooses one for the active view.
default.help: The vision simulation every view shows until you choose another for it, usually none. Example: deuteranopia to review colour use. Ctrl+Shift+Space, O, I chooses one for the active view.

blurPx.label: Blur of blurred vision (px)
blurPx.description: How blurred Blurred vision (myopia) is at full strength, in CSS px (0 to 20). Chromium views draw their own blur unless Prefer Chromium's own emulation is off or a strength is chosen.
blurPx.help: How blurred the blurred-vision simulation is at full strength, in CSS px (0 to 20). Chromium views draw their own blur unless native emulation is off or a strength is chosen.

preferNative.label: Prefer Chromium's own emulation
preferNative.description: Chromium views render protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, achromatopsia, blurred vision and low contrast themselves when no strength is chosen; off, the plugin's page script draws every simulation.
preferNative.help: Chromium views render protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, achromatopsia, blurred vision and low contrast themselves when no strength is chosen, which is faster; off, the plugin's page script draws every simulation.

persist.label: Keep simulations after a restart
persist.description: Off: every start begins with the default simulation in every view. On: each view keeps its simulation in .rbrowser/out/simulators/ across restarts.
persist.help: Each view keeps its simulation in .rbrowser/out/simulators/ across restarts. Off starts every session with the default simulation.
